description: A null for_each is an error
notes: The README doesn't say what a null for_each does, and the spec asks applications to treat an attribute whose value is null as if it weren't there, so generating no blocks, or whatever a missing for_each does, would be other readings. hashicorp/hcl reports it as an error (expandBody.decodeSpec in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go).
reference_error: Cannot use a null value in for_each
